from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from one document to build the citation graph."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the provided collection that this paper cites")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
